t: A two-day unplugged lesson that simulates next-word prediction with dice.
steps: Find Large Language MadLibs on the Model AI Assignments page.
Download the slides and the worksheets.
Print the student and teacher worksheets.
Gather a pair of 4-sided dice and a pair of coins for each group.
Choose a dice-rolling website if you lack dice.
Read the discussion guide and the rubric.
